staging.AlarmName: a-iep-staging a bounced or complained address was not recorded
staging.AlarmDescription:
[STAGING] [WARNING] A bounced address could not be added to the do-not-email list
Impact: Staging only. No real families are affected.
Fires when: at least 1 unrecorded address in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the bounce handler logs and search for SES_SUPPRESSION_WRITE_FAILED.
2. Check the suppression table for throttling or a permissions change.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/staging/docs/RUNBOOK.md#email-sending-reputation

staging.AlarmName: a-iep-staging a document failed to process
staging.AlarmDescription:
[STAGING] [WARNING] A document failed to process
Impact: Staging only. No real families are affected.
Fires when: at least 1 failed document in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the logs for the pipeline database writes function and search for RECORD_FAILURE to see which step failed.
2. If several documents failed, check the status pages for Mistral, OpenAI and AWS Comprehend.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/staging/docs/RUNBOOK.md#documents-are-failing-to-process
Recovery: quiet

staging.AlarmName: a-iep-staging a document kept text we said we would delete
staging.AlarmDescription:
[STAGING] [WARNING] Extracted IEP text was not deleted after a summary was made
Impact: Staging only. No real families are affected.
Fires when: at least 1 failed text deletion in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Run scripts/audit-residue.py (read-only) to list the documents that still hold the text.
2. Remove it with scripts/purge-redacted-ocr.py, which does a dry run first.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/staging/docs/RUNBOOK.md#student-records-were-not-removed
Recovery: quiet

staging.AlarmName: a-iep-staging a failed document kept its unredacted copy
staging.AlarmDescription:
[STAGING] [WARNING] Unredacted student information was left in storage after a failed document
Impact: Staging only. No real families are affected.
Fires when: at least 1 retained copy in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Run scripts/audit-residue.py (read-only) to list what was left behind.
2. Remove it with scripts/purge-orphaned-artifacts.py, which does a dry run first.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/staging/docs/RUNBOOK.md#student-records-were-not-removed
Recovery: quiet

staging.AlarmName: a-iep-staging a family got English only: a requested translation was left out
staging.AlarmDescription:
[STAGING] [WARNING] A requested translation was left out of a summary
Impact: Staging only. No real families are affected.
Fires when: at least 1 skipped translation in 15 minutes.

Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/staging/docs/RUNBOOK.md#documents-are-failing-to-process

staging.AlarmName: a-iep-staging a parent asked us to delete their records and we did not
staging.AlarmDescription:
[STAGING] [WARNING] A deletion request was only partly carried out

staging.AlarmDescription:
[STAGING] [WARNING] Many sign-in emails are bouncing
Impact: This reads an account-wide signal, so production is affected too.
Fires when: a bounce rate of 2% or more.
Check first:
1. Open the SES console reputation page and see which messages bounced.
2. Check the do-not-email list is being updated, and look for abuse (see the runbook).
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/staging/docs/RUNBOOK.md#email-sending-reputation

Impact: This reads an account-wide signal, so production is affected too.
Fires when: a bounce rate of 3.5% or more.
Check first:
1. Open the SES console reputation page and see which messages bounced.
2. Pause or tighten email sign-in if the cause is abuse (see the runbook), and open an AWS Support case early.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/staging/docs/RUNBOOK.md#email-sending-reputation
Recovery: The email bounce rate has dropped

2. Look for abuse sending codes to addresses that did not ask for them (see the runbook).

production.AlarmName: a-iep a bounced or complained address was not recorded
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [WARNING] A bounced address could not be added to the do-not-email list
Impact: No parent is affected yet. That address will be emailed again, which is how an email suspension starts.
Fires when: at least 1 unrecorded address in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the bounce handler logs and search for SES_SUPPRESSION_WRITE_FAILED.
2. Check the suppression table for throttling or a permissions change.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#email-sending-reputation

production.AlarmName: a-iep a document failed to process
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [WARNING] A document failed to process
Impact: The parent who uploaded it sees an error instead of a summary. One unreadable file is common; several in a short time points to a provider outage.
Fires when: at least 1 failed document in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the logs for the pipeline database writes function and search for RECORD_FAILURE to see which step failed.
2. If several documents failed, check the status pages for Mistral, OpenAI and AWS Comprehend.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#documents-are-failing-to-process
Recovery: quiet

production.AlarmName: a-iep a document kept text we said we would delete
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [CRITICAL] Extracted IEP text was not deleted after a summary was made
Impact: Administrators must act: the family's summary is fine, but the leftover text should not exist and needs removing.
Fires when: at least 1 failed text deletion in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Run scripts/audit-residue.py (read-only) to list the documents that still hold the text.
2. Remove it with scripts/purge-redacted-ocr.py, which does a dry run first.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#student-records-were-not-removed
Recovery: quiet

production.AlarmName: a-iep a failed document kept its unredacted copy
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [CRITICAL] Unredacted student information was left in storage after a failed document
Impact: Administrators must act: one family's original upload or raw text should have been deleted and was not. Nothing is visible to parents.
Fires when: at least 1 retained copy in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Run scripts/audit-residue.py (read-only) to list what was left behind.
2. Remove it with scripts/purge-orphaned-artifacts.py, which does a dry run first.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#student-records-were-not-removed
Recovery: quiet

production.AlarmName: a-iep a family got English only: a requested translation was left out
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [WARNING] A requested translation was left out of a summary
Impact: One family has the English summary instead of their language. The app offers them "Translate it now", but they may not notice.
Fires when: at least 1 skipped translation in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the translation step logs and search for TRANSLATION_SKIPPED to see which language was affected.
2. If it repeats for one language, test that language with a synthetic document on staging.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#documents-are-failing-to-process

production.AlarmName: a-iep a parent asked us to delete their records and we did not
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [CRITICAL] A deletion request was only partly carried out
Impact: Administrators must act: a parent asked for a child's documents or profile to be removed, and some of it still exists.
Fires when: at least 1 incomplete deletion in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the user profile function logs and search for DELETION_INCOMPLETE to find the user and step.
2. Remove what is left by hand and confirm it is gone before telling the parent (see the runbook).
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#student-records-were-not-removed
Recovery: quiet

production.AlarmName: a-iep alerting itself is broken
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [CRITICAL] Alerts are not being formatted, so Slack may look quiet
Impact: Administrators may miss real problems. Alarms still fire in CloudWatch, but their Slack messages are failing.
Fires when: at least 1 formatter error in 5 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the CloudWatch alarms page and look for any alarms in the ALARM state.
2. Open the alert formatter logs and read the latest error.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#the-alerting-itself-is-broken
Recovery: Alerts are being formatted again

Recovery: Alerts are being delivered again

Fires when: at least 1 incomplete cleanup in 15 minutes.

1. Open the pipeline database writes function logs and search for DELETION_INCOMPLETE scope=replaced-document to find the child and the old document.

Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#an-old-iep-was-not-cleaned-up-after-a-replacement
Recovery: quiet

2. Open that route's function logs, or check for a recent deploy that could have caused it.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#the-app-is-returning-errors

Impact: Those parents get no code. Sign-in emails should never be rejected, so this is about what is being sent.
Fires when: at least 1 rejected email in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the SES console and read the reject reason.
2. Check the email content and the sending identity have not changed.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#email-sending-reputation
Recovery: quiet

production.AlarmName: a-iep document stuck: pipeline execution timed out

Impact: The parent is still on the processing screen and has no error message.
Fires when: at least 1 timed-out run in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Find the timed-out execution in the Step Functions console for the document pipeline and note the step it stopped at.
2. Mark the document as failed by hand so the parent can retry (see the runbook).
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#documents-are-failing-to-process

Impact: No one yet. At 5% AWS puts the account under review; this fires at 2%, while there is room to act.
Fires when: a bounce rate of 2% or more.
Check first:
1. Open the SES console reputation page and see which messages bounced.
2. Check the do-not-email list is being updated, and look for abuse (see the runbook).

production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [CRITICAL] The email bounce rate is close to the suspension limit
Impact: If AWS suspends email sending, no parent can sign in by email, and getting it back means an appeal to AWS.
Fires when: a bounce rate of 3.5% or more.
Check first:
1. Open the SES console reputation page and see which messages bounced.
2. Pause or tighten email sign-in if the cause is abuse (see the runbook), and open an AWS Support case early.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#email-sending-reputation
Recovery: The email bounce rate has dropped

Check first:
1. Open the SES console reputation page and see the complaint rate.
2. Look for abuse sending codes to addresses that did not ask for them (see the runbook).

production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [CRITICAL] The spam complaint rate is close to the suspension limit
Impact: If AWS suspends email sending, no parent can sign in by email, and getting it back means an appeal to AWS.
Fires when: a spam complaint rate of 0.08% or more.
Check first:
1. Open the SES console reputation page and see the complaint rate.
2. Stop the source of the complaints (see the runbook) and open an AWS Support case early.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#email-sending-reputation
Recovery: The spam complaint rate has dropped

production.AlarmName: a-iep email login codes are arriving late
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [INFO] Sign-in emails are being delivered late
Impact: Parents wait on an empty inbox and may ask for another code. The code usually still arrives.
Fires when: at least 3 delayed emails in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the SES console and see which receiving providers are delaying delivery.
2. No action is needed unless it continues for hours.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#email-sending-reputation
Recovery: quiet

Impact: Parents who sign in by email are turned away. The service-wide limit on emailed codes has been used up.
Fires when: at least 1 refused email in 5 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the sign-in code creation logs and search for EMAIL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED to see how fast it was used.
2. Decide whether this is abuse (see the runbook) or real demand.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#sign-in-codes-are-not-arriving
Recovery: quiet

2. Check the SES console for a sending pause, and the AWS Health dashboard.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#sign-in-codes-are-not-arriving
Recovery: quiet

production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [CRITICAL] Sign-in is running slow at the code creation step
Impact: Cognito gives up on a sign-in step after 5 seconds, so parents may be turned away even though no error shows.

Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#sign-in-is-failing-or-slow
Recovery: Sign-in speed is back to normal at the code creation step

production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [WARNING] Many sign-in attempts are being turned away
Impact: Either someone is attacking sign-in and our limits are holding, or the limits are too tight and real parents are locked out.
Fires when: at least 25 refused sign-ins in 5 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the sign-in start logs and search for AUTH_START_REFUSED to see the reason and whether the requests come from one source.
2. Ask a parent or test a sign-in yourself to rule out real users being blocked.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#suspected-abuse

Impact: Either an abuse run is under way and the limits are holding, or the limits are too tight and real families cannot join.
Fires when: at least 10 refused sign-ups in 5 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the signup logs and search for SIGNUP_REFUSED to see the reasons and whether they come from one source.
2. Test a normal signup yourself to rule out real families being blocked.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#suspected-abuse

production.AlarmDescription:

Impact: Families fill in the form and are told it did not work.
Fires when: at least 3 failed sign-ups in 5 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the signup logs and search for SIGNUP_FAILED to see the Cognito error.
2. Check for a recent change to the user pool or the signup function.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#sign-up-is-failing
Recovery: Accounts are being created again

production.AlarmName: a-iep signup broken: nobody can create an account
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [CRITICAL] Sign-up is down
Impact: No new family can create an account. This is the only way to join.
Fires when: at least 1 error in 5 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the signup function logs and read the latest error.
2. Check for a recent deploy and roll back if it lines up.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#sign-up-is-failing
Recovery: Sign-up is working again

production.AlarmName: a-iep signup flood: someone is abusing the signup form
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [CRITICAL] A flood of new accounts is being created
Impact: No one yet. Each account sends a text, so this burns the monthly SMS budget and can leave parents without sign-in codes.
Fires when: at least 20 signups on real numbers or addresses in 5 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the signup logs and look at the phone prefixes and timing of the new accounts.
2. Confirm the bot check is on, then follow the abuse steps in the runbook.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#suspected-abuse
Recovery: Account creation is back to a normal rate

production.AlarmName: a-iep signup throttled: nobody can create an account
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [CRITICAL] Sign-up is being throttled
Impact: New families are turned away because the signup function is at its capacity limit.
Fires when: at least 1 throttled request in 5 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the signup logs and check whether the volume is a flood (see the runbook) or real demand.
2. If it is real demand, raise the function's reserved concurrency.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#sign-up-is-failing
Recovery: Sign-up is no longer being throttled

production.AlarmName: a-iep signup volume far above normal, test accounts included
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [WARNING] Far more signups than normal, most on test numbers
Impact: No one yet. Test numbers cannot receive texts, so nothing is spent, but the account list is filling up.
Fires when: at least 150 signup attempts in 5 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the signup logs and compare SIGNUP_ATTEMPT destination=fictional with destination=reachable.
2. If no test run was going on, follow the abuse steps in the runbook.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#suspected-abuse
Recovery: Signup volume is back to normal

production.AlarmName: a-iep SMS spend is climbing fast: an abuse run may be under way
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [CRITICAL] SMS spending is climbing unusually fast
Impact: No one yet. If it continues, the monthly cap is hit and no parent can receive a sign-in code.
Fires when: SMS spend above $2 an hour.
Check first:
1. Open the sign-in code creation logs and look at the destinations and signup volume for the last hour.
2. If it is abuse, tighten the signup limits before the cap is reached (see the runbook).
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#sms-spend-and-the-monthly-cap
Recovery: SMS spending is back to a normal rate

production.AlarmName: a-iep SMS spend is past 80% of the monthly cap
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [WARNING] SMS spending is close to the monthly cap
Impact: No one yet. At the cap, no parent can receive a sign-in code until the month rolls over.
Fires when: month-to-date SMS spend above $48.
Check first:
1. Check whether this month's signups explain the spend, or whether it is abuse (see the runbook).
2. Decide whether to raise the SNS monthly spend limit before the cap is hit.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#sms-spend-and-the-monthly-cap

production.AlarmName: a-iep someone marked an A-IEP login code as spam
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [WARNING] Someone marked a sign-in email as spam
Impact: No one is locked out. A code reached someone who did not ask for it. AWS allows about one complaint per thousand emails.
Fires when: at least 1 spam complaint in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the SES console and see the complaint details.
2. Check whether that address was entered on the sign-in form by someone else.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#email-sending-reputation
Recovery: quiet

production.AlarmName: a-iep the daily health brief has stopped running
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [INFO] The daily health summary did not go out
Impact: No one is affected, but a quiet channel no longer means everything is fine.
Fires when: no daily summary sent in 24 hours.
Check first:
1. Open the daily brief schedule in EventBridge and confirm the rule is enabled.
2. Open the daily brief function logs and look for errors.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#the-alerting-itself-is-broken

production.AlarmName: a-iep the daily health brief is failing
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [WARNING] The daily health summary failed to send
Impact: No one is affected, but a quiet channel no longer means everything is fine.
Fires when: at least 1 failed summary in 1 hour.
Check first:
1. Open the daily brief function logs and read the latest error.
2. Check that it can still publish to the alert topic.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#the-alerting-itself-is-broken

production.AlarmName: a-iep the do-not-email list is not being maintained
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [WARNING] The do-not-email list is not being updated
Impact: No parent is affected yet. Addresses that bounced or complained will be emailed again, and the account is heading for an AWS review.
Fires when: at least 3 handler errors in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the bounce handler logs and read the latest error.
2. Check that the handler is still subscribed to the SES event topic.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#email-sending-reputation

production.AlarmName: a-iep the monthly SMS cap is reached and login codes are being binned
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [CRITICAL] The monthly SMS spending cap has been reached
Impact: No parent in either environment can receive a sign-in code by text until the limit is raised or the month rolls over.
Fires when: at least 1 dropped text in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Check for signup abuse first (see the runbook), because raising the cap during an attack pays for the attack.
2. If the traffic is real, raise the SNS monthly spend limit and update SMS_MONTHLY_LIMIT_USD in monitoring.ts.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#sms-spend-and-the-monthly-cap
Recovery: quiet

production.AlarmName: a-iep the pipeline cannot write to its database
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [WARNING] Document progress is not being saved
Impact: Parents may see a progress bar that never moves, or an upload that never reports what went wrong.
Fires when: at least 5 failed database writes in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the logs for the pipeline database writes function and search for DDB_SERVICE_ERROR to see which write failed.
2. Check the AWS Health dashboard and the DynamoDB console for a service event or throttling.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#documents-are-failing-to-process

production.AlarmName: a-iep the signup bot check is switched off
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [WARNING] The sign-up bot check is switched off
Impact: Sign-ups still work, but the defence against scripts is missing. The rate limits still apply.
Fires when: at least 1 unchecked sign-up in 5 minutes.
Check first:
1. Check that the Turnstile secret parameter exists for this environment in Parameter Store.
2. If it is missing, create it (see the runbook).
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#sign-up-is-failing

production.AlarmName: a-iep the SMS provider is rejecting login codes
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [CRITICAL] The SMS provider is rejecting sign-in codes
Impact: Parents who sign in by phone are told a code is coming and none arrives, in both prod and staging. Often this is the monthly spend cap.
Fires when: at least 1 rejected text in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Check the SMS spend against the monthly cap in the SNS console.
2. Open the SNS delivery failure log group and read the provider response on the latest failures.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#sms-spend-and-the-monthly-cap
Recovery: quiet

production.AlarmName: a-iep the wrong-code limit is not being enforced
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [WARNING] The limit on wrong sign-in codes is switched off
Impact: Parents can still sign in. Repeated wrong guesses are limited only by Cognito's own three tries per code.
Fires when: at least 5 missed checks in 5 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the sign-in verify logs and search for AUTH_VERIFY_COUNTER_UNAVAILABLE.
2. Check the login rate limiting table for throttling or access errors.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#sign-in-is-failing-or-slow

production.AlarmName: a-iep undelivered login codes are not being counted
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [WARNING] The counter for undelivered sign-in codes is broken
Impact: No one yet. The alert for undelivered codes cannot fire until this is fixed.
Fires when: at least 1 classifier error in 15 minutes.
Check first:
1. Open the SMS failure classifier logs and read the latest error.
2. Check that its permissions and the log subscription were not changed by a recent deploy.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#sign-in-codes-are-not-arriving

production.AlarmName: a-iep unusual AWS API volume
production.AlarmDescription:
[PROD] [INFO] Something is making unusually many calls to AWS
Impact: No one. It is usually a script or an automated agent left running.
Fires when: at least 10000 encryption calls in 1 hour.
Check first:
1. Look in CloudTrail for the identity making the most KMS calls in the last hour.
2. Stop it if it is a script or agent you recognise.
Runbook: https://github.com/The-Burnes-Center/a-iep/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md#unusual-aws-api-volume
